$source: Self-consistency vectors — encrypt/decrypt roundtrip with deterministic inputs to detect implementation regression
$note: Strict NIST CAVP AES-GCM vectors (gcmEncryptIntIV256.rsp, etc.) require checked-in vector files (~5MB) — pulled in v2.x via the 'fetch-vectors' build script. Self-consistency provides a smoke-test floor that catches @noble/ciphers swap or tamper.
